prompt: Use case: compositing. Asset type: seamless water-only albedo texture for the Yas Marina 3D circuit terrain. The supplied image is the earlier licensed Planet satellite photograph and is a COLOR/TEXTURE REFERENCE only. Create a square flat top-down seamless texture of the calm Yas Marina water, matching the beautiful blue-green teal seawater in this reference. Fill the entire square edge-to-edge with water only. Natural muted turquoise/teal, depth variations, small soft ripples, diffuse daylight. Main median sRGB around #256571, shallow tonal variation between #235761 and #347A80; never black. Subtle realistic texture rather than a flat solid fill. No dramatic waves, no white foam, no caustics grid, no large white highlights. No land, shoreline, boats, piers, buildings, shadows, text, or objects; geography and shoreline will be applied separately through exact masks in Blender. No vignette or dark corners. All edges must seamlessly tile. This is a water material derived from the supplied reference, not a satellite map and not a request to move or invent geographic objects.
